shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a stone surface
bird-like head with beak in profile
repeated figures arranged in a horizontal frieze band
justification: Both surfaces present low-relief figures arranged as a horizontal frieze of repeated creatures in profile, with beaked/animal heads and limbs raised upward, and both combine animal and quasi-anthropomorphic bodies in a single register. However, A stacks several distinct registers with a large predator/bird above a smaller crouching figure and a separate long-necked bird below, plus abstract linear motifs, while B shows a single continuous row of near-identical dancing-like figures with arms lifted overhead and no comparable multi-register or symbolic elements.
